release_notes: v0.4.7: Supportability, Health Page & Performance Diagnostics. Adds the admin System Health page at /support, a PII-safe support bundle download, a timing ledger for batch performance analysis, the /api/support/timings endpoint, an upgraded /api/support/status, better worker/DB/disk/audio-tool diagnostics, and a fix for the support-status batch_id lookup bug. Improves 50/100/300-call test readiness. Includes all v0.4.6.1 worker startup hotfix improvements. The premium 300+ call engine remains planned for v0.5.0.
